# Shared blend-seam fixture (issue #96).
#
# Read by BOTH sides so the editor and the runtime cannot drift apart:
#   Dart — test/domain/animation/blend_fixture_test.dart
#   Rust — engine/kineto_engine/tests/blend.rs
#
# Grammar, one directive per line, whitespace separated:
#   case <name> <ordered|mixed>   starts a case
#   base <subject> <key> <s|c> <value>    rest-pose value (ordered cases only)
#   sample <weight> <0|1>         starts a sample; the flag is `enabled`
#   value <subject> <key> <s|c> <value>   a property the current sample carries
#   expect <subject> <key> <s|c> <value>  the folded result
#   absent <subject> <key>        the folded result must not carry this key
#   end                           closes the case
#
# `s` values are decimal; `c` values are 8-digit hex ARGB. Scalars compare
# within 1e-9; colour channels compare within 1, because a half-way channel
# rounds to either side of .5 depending on the host's rounding.

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Ordered semantics: acc = lerp(acc, sample, weight), in list order.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# A lone full-weight sample passes straight through.
case single_sample ordered
sample 1 1
value nodeA positionX s 10
expect nodeA positionX s 10
end

# Two full-weight samples: the later one wins the property they share.
case override_priority ordered
sample 1 1
value nodeA positionX s 10
value nodeA positionY s 1
sample 1 1
value nodeA positionX s 20
expect nodeA positionX s 20
expect nodeA positionY s 1
end

# Reversing the order reverses the winner, and nothing else.
case override_priority_reversed ordered
sample 1 1
value nodeA positionX s 20
sample 1 1
value nodeA positionX s 10
expect nodeA positionX s 10
end

# Sparse: a property nobody produces is absent, so the base document shows.
case sparse_absent ordered
sample 1 1
value nodeA positionX s 10
expect nodeA positionX s 10
absent nodeA positionY
absent nodeB positionX
end

# Subjects do not bleed into one another.
case independent_subjects ordered
sample 1 1
value nodeA positionX s 1
sample 1 1
value nodeB positionX s 2
expect nodeA positionX s 1
expect nodeB positionX s 2
end

# The crossfade shape: [from @ 1, to @ p] resolves to lerp(from, to, p).
case crossfade_quarter ordered
sample 1 1
value nodeA positionX s 0
sample 0.25 1
value nodeA positionX s 100
expect nodeA positionX s 25
end

case crossfade_midpoint ordered
sample 1 1
value nodeA positionX s 0
sample 0.5 1
value nodeA positionX s 100
expect nodeA positionX s 50
end

# Colours interpolate channel-wise and stay opaque — the whole point of
# blending values instead of compositing two renders at partial alpha.
case crossfade_colour ordered
sample 1 1
value nodeA fillColor c FF000000
sample 0.5 1
value nodeA fillColor c FFFFFFFF
expect nodeA fillColor c FF808080
end

# A partial-weight first contribution blends away from the rest pose.
case base_seeding ordered
base nodeA positionX s 100
sample 0.25 1
value nodeA positionX s 200
expect nodeA positionX s 125
end

# With no base for that property, the first contribution lands whole rather
# than fading toward a phantom zero.
case no_base_lands_whole ordered
sample 0.25 1
value nodeA positionX s 200
expect nodeA positionX s 200
end

# A disabled sample contributes nothing and does not even seed a property.
case disabled_sample ordered
sample 1 1
value nodeA positionX s 10
sample 1 0
value nodeA positionX s 999
value nodeA positionY s 999
expect nodeA positionX s 10
absent nodeA positionY
end

# Zero weight is the same result, reached a different way.
case zero_weight ordered
sample 1 1
value nodeA positionX s 10
sample 0 1
value nodeA positionX s 999
expect nodeA positionX s 10
end

# Weights outside 0..1 clamp.
case weight_clamped ordered
sample 1 1
value nodeA positionX s 0
sample 4 1
value nodeA positionX s 100
expect nodeA positionX s 100
end

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Discrete properties: indices, never interpolated. Winner-takes-all at 0.5.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

case discrete_below_threshold ordered
sample 1 1
value nodeA drawOrder s 1
sample 0.49 1
value nodeA drawOrder s 7
expect nodeA drawOrder s 1
end

case discrete_at_threshold ordered
sample 1 1
value nodeA drawOrder s 1
sample 0.5 1
value nodeA drawOrder s 7
expect nodeA drawOrder s 7
end

case discrete_blend_mode ordered
sample 1 1
value nodeA blendMode s 0
sample 0.6 1
value nodeA blendMode s 3
expect nodeA blendMode s 3
end

case discrete_solo_index ordered
sample 1 1
value nodeA soloIndex s 0
sample 0.4 1
value nodeA soloIndex s 3
expect nodeA soloIndex s 0
end

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Kind conflicts: nothing interpolates across kinds, so 0.5 decides.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

case kind_conflict_keeps_current ordered
sample 1 1
value nodeA positionX s 1
sample 0.25 1
value nodeA positionX c FFFF0000
expect nodeA positionX s 1
end

case kind_conflict_takes_incoming ordered
sample 1 1
value nodeA positionX s 1
sample 0.75 1
value nodeA positionX c FFFF0000
expect nodeA positionX c FFFF0000
end

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Normalised semantics: a weighted mean, for blend trees.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

case mix_weighted_mean mixed
sample 0.25 1
value nodeA positionX s 0
sample 0.75 1
value nodeA positionX s 100
expect nodeA positionX s 75
end

case mix_normalises_short_weights mixed
sample 0.1 1
value nodeA positionX s 0
sample 0.1 1
value nodeA positionX s 100
expect nodeA positionX s 50
end

case mix_three_points mixed
sample 0.2 1
value nodeA positionX s 0
sample 0.3 1
value nodeA positionX s 50
sample 0.5 1
value nodeA positionX s 100
expect nodeA positionX s 65
end

case mix_colour mixed
sample 0.5 1
value nodeA fillColor c FF000000
sample 0.5 1
value nodeA fillColor c FFFFFFFF
expect nodeA fillColor c FF808080
end
